verdict.rationale: Orb's own docs say it automatically calculates recognized revenue in line with ASC 606 guidelines and tracks recognized and deferred revenue, with exports to financial systems. The evidence is limited to one-line claims, though: IFRS 15 is never mentioned, and there is no detail on deferred revenue schedules or audit-ready recognition reports. Missing for 10: IFRS 15 support, documented deferred revenue schedule views, audit-ready recognition report outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Orb automatically calculates recognized revenue in a way that accords with ASC606 guidelines.
Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
